title: Lanes
description: Hairline lanes stream in as a tight ribbon, peel off one by one to draw the outline of the type, and the word fills solid. It leaves the same way in reverse: the fill melts to outline and every line runs out along its own lane.

title: Pipework
description: Shaded tubes arrive packed side by side like a cable harness, jog through right-angle bends and plumb themselves into the outline of the type, which stays as tube letters. On exit the tubes unplug and bend away down their lanes.

title: Twist
description: Pairs the departing strands of one word with the arriving strands of the next, gathers them into a tight cable and winds them around the cable axis in a helix before they fan back out. Tune it with turns and handed.

title: Circuit board
description: Routes the strands like traces on a circuit board: they step in on 45 degree turns into a lane-split bus, run a chicane and dog-legs on an orthogonal grid, and step back out to the next word's entry, with via rings lighting up at every corner.

title: Spiral around
description: Rolls the strands up into a ring and spirals them around an object, a cylinder, a sphere or the flat slab of a word block, drawn as a faint wireframe, before unrolling them into the next word's entry. Pick the object with around and the winding with turns and handed.

title: Braid
description: Splits the strands into three plaits and weaves them over and under each other like a braid before they settle into the next word's entry. Tune it with cycles and handed.

title: Fan
description: Spreads the bundle into a flat fan: each strand takes its own ray, the outer strands sweep wide apart with a faint web between them, and the rays gather back into the next word's entry.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS > FLOW (demo camera)
description: Three modules, two transitions, each word on its own plane: lanes SIGNAL (left, tilted) -> right-handed twist -> pipework BENDS (upper right) -> left-handed three-turn twist -> lanes FLOW (lower centre, front-facing). Fixed demo camera.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS > FLOW (follow camera)
description: Three modules, two transitions, each word on its own plane: lanes SIGNAL (left, tilted) -> right-handed twist -> pipework BENDS (upper right) -> left-handed three-turn twist -> lanes FLOW (lower centre, front-facing). A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS via circuit_board (follow camera)
description: Two modules chained by a circuit_board transition: lanes SIGNAL (left, tilted) releases its lines, they step into a lane-split bus on 45 degree traces, run a chicane and step out into the tubes of BENDS (pipework, upper right), with via rings at the corners. A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.

title: BENDS > FLOW via spiral_around (follow camera)
description: Two modules chained by a spiral_around transition: pipework BENDS (upper left) releases its tubes, they roll into a ring and spiral round a faint cylinder, then unroll into lanes FLOW (lower right). A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.

title: SIGNAL > BENDS via braid (follow camera)
description: Two modules chained by a braid transition: lanes SIGNAL releases its lines, they split in three plaits that weave over and under each other, then enter BENDS (pipework). A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.

title: BENDS > FLOW via fan (follow camera)
description: Two modules chained by a fan transition: pipework BENDS releases its tubes, they spread into a flat fan sweep and gather into lanes FLOW. A FlowPath camera follows the strands and rests on each formed word.
